scope: post-Stage-5 self-sufficiency work, beginning with Stage 5.12e
invariants: NEX-1 v0.1 Core is not changed to make a candidate pass
resource refusal is recorded separately from semantic invalidity
resource budgets are not increased after observing a candidate result
failed or slow cases are not deleted from the same candidate version
a candidate that fails hold-out is rejected; any semantic or algorithmic change requires a new candidate version and a new hold-out set
verifier-only repairs are allowed only when they do not change candidate wire, workload inputs, expected semantic results, or resource budgets
all cases observed before this protocol are development evidence and are never relabeled as hold-out

go_normative_cbn.acceptance_role: measurement_only_for_representation_candidate; refusals do not by themselves imply semantic invalidity

historical_classification.interleaved-pair-v0.1: rejected candidate with reproduced negative result
historical_classification.functional-stream-v0.1: development candidate already observed; failed frozen sharing transition budget on repeat length 32/128

active_candidate.representation: Stream = N -> N, values 0/1 with EOF=2
active_candidate.algorithm_change_from_v0.1: repeat uses direct indexed recursion over (count,index) rather than recursively materializing a cons chain

development_workload.classification: previously observed workload; suitable for regression/development only
acceptance: Python and Go principal types match frozen expectations
all fully applied cases return frozen Nat observations
Python and Go call-by-need have zero resource refusals under frozen budgets
Python and Go call-by-need observations agree on all cases
Go CBN resource outcomes are reported separately

holdout.execution_rule: do not run until functional-stream-v0.2 passes its frozen development workload and the candidate artifact is unchanged after that pass
holdout.failure_rule: if any semantic mismatch or call-by-need resource refusal occurs, reject functional-stream-v0.2; do not modify v0.2 and rerun the same hold-out

ci_policy.active_candidate: fast contract plus active candidate check on candidate changes
ci_policy.historical_regression: run at explicit research checkpoints, frozen-evidence changes, and before merge; it is not required to block each active-candidate edit
ci_policy.final_merge: requires current candidate evidence, historical regression, research re-audit, and dissertation synchronization to be green/current
